title: Slushie Bar Salts Watermelon Ice 10ml E-Liquid
description: Watermelon Ice by Slushie Bar Salts is a delightful fusion of ripe, succulent Watermelon and a cool, refreshing icy finish. This e-liquid captures the essence of biting into a juicy Watermelon slice on a hot day, followed by an exhilarating icy sensation that cools and refreshes. The initial taste is of sweet, ripe Watermelon, bursting with natural juiciness. This subtle, fruity sweetness is then perfectly complemented by a wave of cool ice, adding a refreshing twist that elevates the flavour to a giddy new heights. This premium e-liquid’s 50VG/50PG blend hits the sweet spot between flavour and cloud production and the unique nicotine salt solution makes it ideal for use in classic e-cigarette starter kits and pod devices. Perfect for recent ex-smokers or vapers seeking the immediate, satisfying nicotine relief provided by nic salts. If you enjoy this flavour, there are plenty more Slushie Bar Salts flavours to try. Few e-liquid makers have mastered the icy joys of slushy flavours quite like Slushie, a UK company who are behind an irresistible line of 50ml and 100ml shortfill and Nic Salts e-liquids that blend mouth-watering fruit flavours with healthy doses of icy menthol for an unparalleled slushy vaping experience. We’re also thrilled to stock Slushy Bar Salts: Nic Salt e-liquids that capture the intense flavour and satisfaction of your favourite disposable vape flavours in handy 10ml bottles for use with a wide variety of MTL (mouth-to-lung) vape kits.
